part.text:
The robot did not reach the red wall. It fell and is now lying on its back, resting. I called `rest`.

I followed the corridor through several left turns and then a section with a wall close on the right. In that last section the foot bumper kept triggering and blocked my moves. I got free and turned left, then the robot fell. Standing up failed, and the tool said getting up after a fall is unreliable in this simulator. I never saw the red wall.

Someone needs to reset the robot before it can continue. The odometry also reset to zero after the fall, so it no longer shows where the robot is in the corridor.
